desc: bat is a cat replacement that adds syntax highlighting, line numbers and Git change markers to file output.

name: fd
desc: fd is a fast and simpler alternative to find, with sensible defaults such as ignoring hidden and .gitignored files.

name: jq
desc: jq is a command-line JSON processor for filtering, transforming and pretty-printing JSON, such as API responses and cloud CLI output.

name: yq
desc: yq is a jq-style command-line processor for YAML, JSON and XML, which is handy for editing Kubernetes manifests and CI files in scripts.

name: zoxide
desc: zoxide is a smarter cd that remembers the directories you use and jumps to them from a partial name.

name: delta
desc: delta is a pager for git diff and grep output that adds syntax highlighting, side-by-side views and line numbers.

name: eza
desc: eza is a modern replacement for ls with colours, icons, Git status and a tree view.

name: hyperfine
desc: hyperfine benchmarks shell commands with warm-up runs and statistical analysis, so you can compare tools or flags reliably.

name: curl
desc: curl transfers data to and from URLs over HTTP, FTP, SMTP and many other protocols, and is the standard tool for testing APIs from a shell.
license_note: The winget manifest declares `Freeware`; curl is published under its own MIT-style `curl` licence (<https://curl.se/docs/copyright.html>).

name: Fastfetch
desc: Fastfetch prints a quick summary of the operating system, hardware and shell in the terminal.

name: btop4win
desc: btop4win is the Windows port of btop, a terminal resource monitor for CPU, memory, disks, network and processes.

name: tlrc
desc: tlrc is the official Rust client for tldr-pages, which shows short, example-driven help for common command-line tools.

name: Wget
desc: This is a native Windows build of GNU Wget, the non-interactive downloader for HTTP, HTTPS and FTP that can resume and mirror sites.

name: Helix
desc: Helix is a modal terminal text editor with built-in language-server support, tree-sitter highlighting and multiple selections.

name: Microsoft Edit
desc: Microsoft Edit is a small, modeless terminal text editor for quick changes, with mouse support and familiar shortcuts.

name: xh
desc: xh is a fast HTTPie-style tool for sending HTTP requests with readable syntax and formatted, coloured responses.

name: Glow
desc: Glow renders Markdown files in the terminal with styling, and can browse a directory of Markdown documents.

name: GNU nano
desc: GNU nano is a small, beginner-friendly terminal text editor, and a common default editor on Linux servers.

name: Zettlr
desc: Zettlr is a Markdown editor for long-form and academic writing, with citations from Zotero, Zettelkasten links and Pandoc export.

name: MarkText
desc: MarkText is a Markdown editor with live preview, so formatting renders as you type.

name: draw.io Desktop
desc: draw.io Desktop is an offline diagramming app for network diagrams, flowcharts, UML and architecture drawings, with shape libraries for AWS, Azure and Cisco.

name: Pandoc
desc: Pandoc converts documents between dozens of markup formats, such as Markdown, Word, HTML, LaTeX and EPUB.

name: Doxygen
desc: Doxygen generates reference documentation from annotated source code in C, C++, Java, Python and other languages.

name: AppFlowy
desc: AppFlowy is an open-source workspace for documents, wikis, kanban boards and databases that you can run locally or self-host.

name: TriliumNext Notes
desc: TriliumNext Notes is a hierarchical note-taking app for building large personal knowledge bases, with scripting and an optional sync server.

name: Notion
desc: Notion is a hosted workspace combining documents, wikis, databases and project boards.

name: Standard Notes
desc: Standard Notes is an end-to-end encrypted notes app with optional self-hosted sync.

name: MiKTeX
desc: MiKTeX is a TeX/LaTeX distribution for Windows that installs missing packages on demand.

name: TeXstudio
desc: TeXstudio is a LaTeX editor with completion, live error checking, a structure view and an integrated PDF viewer.

name: Typora
desc: Typora is a paid Markdown editor that hides the syntax and renders formatting inline as you write.

name: Anytype
desc: Anytype is a local-first, end-to-end encrypted workspace for notes, objects and databases, with peer-to-peer sync.

name: SiYuan
desc: SiYuan is a local-first, block-based knowledge base with bidirectional links, a graph view and optional self-hosting.

name: Fiddler Everywhere
desc: Fiddler Everywhere is a cross-platform HTTP(S) debugging proxy for capturing, inspecting, modifying and replaying web traffic.

name: Fiddler Classic
desc: Fiddler Classic is the long-standing Windows HTTP(S) debugging proxy, with scripting rules and an autoresponder for mocking.

name: Yaak
desc: Yaak is a desktop API client for REST, GraphQL, gRPC and WebSocket that stores workspaces as plain files you can keep in Git.

name: Hoppscotch
desc: Hoppscotch is an open-source API client for REST, GraphQL and real-time protocols, available as a desktop app or a self-hosted web app.

name: Remote Desktop Manager
desc: Remote Desktop Manager centralises RDP, SSH, VNC and web sessions alongside their credentials, with a free tier and paid team editions.

name: TigerVNC
desc: TigerVNC is a high-performance VNC viewer and server, commonly used to reach Linux desktops.

name: RealVNC Viewer
desc: RealVNC Viewer connects to RealVNC Connect servers and to most standard VNC servers.

name: UltraVNC
desc: UltraVNC is a Windows VNC server and viewer with file transfer, chat and optional encryption plugins.

name: Windows App
desc: Windows App is Microsoft's client for Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, Dev Box and Remote Desktop Services, and replaces the older Remote Desktop client.

name: Royal TS
desc: Royal TS is a connection manager for RDP, SSH, VNC, web and other sessions, with shared documents and credential storage.

name: Duplicati
desc: Duplicati is a backup client that stores encrypted, deduplicated and incremental backups on cloud storage, SFTP or local disks, scheduled from a web UI.

name: KopiaUI
desc: KopiaUI is the desktop interface for Kopia, a fast encrypted, deduplicating snapshot backup tool for local, SFTP and cloud repositories.

name: Veeam Agent for Microsoft Windows
desc: Veeam Agent for Microsoft Windows is a free image-level and file-level backup tool for workstations, with bare-metal recovery media.

name: TestDisk & PhotoRec
desc: TestDisk recovers lost partitions and repairs boot sectors, and the bundled PhotoRec carves deleted files out of damaged or formatted media.

name: Recuva
desc: Recuva recovers deleted files from Windows drives, memory cards and USB sticks, with a deep-scan mode.

name: balenaEtcher
desc: balenaEtcher writes OS images to USB drives and SD cards, and checks each write so a bad flash is caught.

name: UrBackup Server
desc: UrBackup is a client/server backup system that combines image and file backups of networked machines, managed from a web interface.

name: AdGuard Home
desc: AdGuard Home is a network-wide DNS server that blocks ads and trackers, and supports DNS-over-HTTPS/TLS upstreams and per-client rules.

name: NetSetMan
desc: NetSetMan switches between saved network profiles, such as IP, gateway, DNS, Wi-Fi and proxy settings, in one click, which helps when you move between lab networks.

name: Grype
desc: Grype scans container images, filesystems and SBOMs for known vulnerabilities in OS and language packages.

name: Syft
desc: Syft generates software bills of materials (SBOMs) in SPDX and CycloneDX format from container images and filesystems.

name: cosign
desc: cosign signs and verifies container images and other artifacts with Sigstore, including keyless signing tied to an OIDC identity.

name: Kubescape
desc: Kubescape scans Kubernetes clusters, manifests and Helm charts against frameworks such as NSA-CISA and the CIS Benchmark.

name: HashiCorp Vault
desc: Vault stores and controls access to secrets, issues dynamic credentials and certificates, and provides encryption as a service.

name: HashiCorp Consul
desc: Consul provides service discovery, health checking, a key/value store and a service mesh across data centres.

name: HashiCorp Nomad
desc: Nomad is a workload orchestrator that schedules containers, VMs and plain binaries across a cluster, with a simpler model than Kubernetes.

name: Argo CD CLI
desc: The argocd CLI manages Argo CD, the GitOps controller that keeps Kubernetes clusters in sync with manifests in Git.

name: Flux CLI
desc: The flux CLI bootstraps and manages Flux, a CNCF GitOps toolkit that reconciles Kubernetes clusters from Git and OCI sources.

name: Kustomize
desc: Kustomize customises Kubernetes YAML through overlays and patches without templates, and is also built into kubectl as -k.

name: kubectx
desc: kubectx switches between kubectl contexts quickly, and its companion kubens switches the default namespace.

name: stern
desc: stern tails logs from multiple Kubernetes pods and containers at once, matched by a name pattern or label selector.

name: Skaffold
desc: Skaffold automates the build-push-deploy loop for Kubernetes applications during local development and in CI.

name: k3d
desc: k3d runs k3s Kubernetes clusters inside Docker containers, which makes it quick to create and destroy multi-node local clusters.

name: Task
desc: Task is a cross-platform task runner and build tool that reads a YAML Taskfile, as a simpler alternative to Make.

name: Docker Compose
desc: Docker Compose defines and runs multi-container applications from a compose.yaml file, and this standalone binary also works with Podman.

name: hadolint
desc: hadolint lints Dockerfiles against best practices and runs ShellCheck on the RUN instructions.

name: GitLab Runner
desc: GitLab Runner is the agent that picks up and executes GitLab CI/CD jobs on your own machines, using shell, Docker or Kubernetes executors.

name: Memurai Developer
desc: Memurai is a Redis-compatible in-memory data store that runs natively on Windows, and the Developer edition is free for development use.

name: DB Browser for SQLite
desc: DB Browser for SQLite is a visual tool for creating, browsing, editing and querying SQLite database files.

name: TablePlus
desc: TablePlus is a native GUI client for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, SQLite, Redis and other databases, with a limited free tier.

name: Neo4j Desktop
desc: Neo4j Desktop manages local Neo4j graph database instances and includes tools for running Cypher queries.

name: SQL Server 2022 Developer
desc: SQL Server 2022 Developer is the full-featured edition of SQL Server, free for development and testing but not for production.

name: SQL Server 2022 Express
desc: SQL Server 2022 Express is the free, size-limited edition of SQL Server that can be used for small production workloads.

name: sqlcmd (go-sqlcmd)
desc: go-sqlcmd is the modern cross-platform sqlcmd for running T-SQL against SQL Server and Azure SQL, and it can also start SQL Server in a container.

name: MongoDB Shell (mongosh)
desc: mongosh is the interactive JavaScript shell for querying and administering MongoDB deployments.

name: Cryptomator
desc: Cryptomator encrypts files client-side before they reach a cloud-sync folder such as OneDrive or Dropbox, presenting the vault as a virtual drive.

name: KeePass
desc: KeePass is the original open-source password manager for Windows, storing credentials in an encrypted local database, and is extensible through plugins.

name: Portmaster
desc: Portmaster is an application firewall that shows and controls every network connection per app, with DNS-level tracker blocking.

name: O&O ShutUp10++
desc: O&O ShutUp10++ is a free tool that explains and toggles Windows 10 and 11 telemetry and privacy settings, with recommended presets.

name: age
desc: age is a simple, modern file encryption tool with small explicit keys and no configuration, and is often used in place of GPG for files and secrets.

name: Mozilla VPN
desc: Mozilla VPN is a paid WireGuard-based VPN service from Mozilla, with an open-source client.

name: Session
desc: Session is an end-to-end encrypted messenger that needs no phone number and routes messages through an onion network.

name: Yubico Authenticator
desc: Yubico Authenticator generates TOTP/HOTP codes from secrets stored on a YubiKey, and manages its FIDO2 and PIV settings.

name: Caddy
desc: Caddy is a web server and reverse proxy that obtains and renews TLS certificates automatically, configured with a short Caddyfile or a JSON API.

name: Flow Launcher
desc: Flow Launcher is a keyboard launcher for Windows that searches apps, files, bookmarks and the web, and is extensible with plugins.

name: Espanso
desc: Espanso is a cross-platform text expander that replaces typed triggers with snippets, dates or script output, configured in YAML.

name: Raspberry Pi Imager
desc: Raspberry Pi Imager writes Raspberry Pi OS and other images to SD cards, and can preconfigure the hostname, SSH, Wi-Fi and users before first boot.

name: Thonny
desc: Thonny is a beginner-friendly Python IDE with a simple debugger, and it can program MicroPython boards such as the Raspberry Pi Pico.
